# libgen9blas: BLAS levels 1-3 + NN ops on Intel Gen9 iGPUs, without NEO (kcl: an OpenCL subset straight on i915).
#
# Kernels are compiled into the library (kernels.c, generated by gen_kernels.py from kernels/*.cl, the tracked asm GEMM
# binaries kernels/gen_*.bin and the attention binaries built by ../asm). Generating them needs ocloc 24.35.30872.36
# (other versions produce other code; docs/pitfalls.md). Without it, point GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS at a directory with
# kernels.c and kernels_gen8.c generated elsewhere (e.g. copied from a build on a machine with that ocloc).
#
#   cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build -L gpu     (GPU tests need a Gen9 iGPU)
#   cmake --install build --prefix ~/.local                                          (RUNPATH $ORIGIN: relocatable)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(gen9blas VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES C)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)

option(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_BLAS_SHIM "libgen9blas_blas.so: full BLAS/CBLAS (S/D on the GPU, the rest forwarded to OpenBLAS)" ON)
option(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_NEO "NEO (OpenCL) comparison builds libgen9blas_neo.so / libgen9blas_blas_neo.so" OFF)
option(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_TESTS "ctest: the Python GPU test suites (label gpu)" ON)
set(GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS "" CACHE PATH "directory with prebuilt kernels.c and kernels_gen8.c (instead of ocloc)")
set(GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION "24.35.30872.36" CACHE STRING "ocloc version the kernels are generated with")

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)          # gnu11: statement expressions, __attribute__
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_library(M_LIB m)
set(MESA ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/mesa)
set(ASM_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../asm)

# ---- kernel tables -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tracked kernel sources and asm binaries (generated dgemm.cl / attention binaries may also sit in kernels/ after a
# Makefile build: never taken from there)
set(KERNEL_FILES hgemm.cl sgemm.cl dgemm_core.cl level12.cl gen8_probe.cl gen_h.bin gen_hd.bin gen_s.bin
                 hgemm_asm.bin hgemm_kc_asm.bin sgemm_asm.bin)
set(KDIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kernels)     # staging: sources + binaries gen_kernels.py reads
set(GENK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_kernels.py)
set(KERNELS_C ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kernels.c)
set(KERNELS_GEN8_C ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kernels_gen8.c)
set(ATTN_TOKC attn_qwen_tokc attn_llama_tokc attn_whisper_tokc attn_qwen7b_tokc attn_qwen3_tokc attn_nemo_tokc
              attn_paddle_tokc attn_ernie_tokc attn_ernie_stokc)

if(GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS)
  foreach(f kernels.c kernels_gen8.c)
    if(NOT EXISTS ${GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS}/${f})
      message(FATAL_ERROR "GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS: ${GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS}/${f} not found")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  configure_file(${GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS}/kernels.c ${KERNELS_C} COPYONLY)
  configure_file(${GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS}/kernels_gen8.c ${KERNELS_GEN8_C} COPYONLY)
  message(STATUS "gen9blas: prebuilt kernel tables from ${GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS}")
else()
  find_program(OCLOC ocloc)
  if(NOT OCLOC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "gen9blas: ocloc not found; install ocloc ${GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION} or set GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS")
  endif()
  execute_process(COMMAND ${OCLOC} query OCL_DRIVER_VERSION WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp OUTPUT_VARIABLE _ov ERROR_QUIET)
  string(STRIP "${_ov}" _ov)
  string(REGEX REPLACE ".*\n" "" _ov "${_ov}")
  if(NOT _ov STREQUAL GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "gen9blas: ocloc ${_ov}, the kernels need ${GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION} (another version produces "
                        "other code); use that ocloc or GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS")
  endif()
  list(TRANSFORM KERNEL_FILES PREPEND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kernels/ OUTPUT_VARIABLE _ksrc)
  set(_staged)
  foreach(f ${_ksrc})
    get_filename_component(n ${f} NAME)
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${KDIR}/${n} COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy ${f} ${KDIR}/${n} DEPENDS ${f} VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND _staged ${KDIR}/${n})
  endforeach()
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${KDIR}/dgemm.cl
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_dgemm.py ${KDIR}/sgemm.cl ${KDIR}/dgemm_core.cl > ${KDIR}/dgemm.cl
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_dgemm.py ${KDIR}/sgemm.cl ${KDIR}/dgemm_core.cl VERBATIM)
  # attention binaries: hand-scheduled from asm/attn.cl by asm/attn_gen.py (pinned ocloc), written into the staging dir
  set(_attn)
  foreach(b ${ATTN_TOKC})
    list(APPEND _attn ${KDIR}/${b}.bin)
  endforeach()
  file(GLOB _asm_deps ${ASM_DIR}/attn*.py ${ASM_DIR}/isa.py ${ASM_DIR}/attn.cl ${ASM_DIR}/Makefile)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_attn}
    COMMAND make -s -C ${ASM_DIR} BIN_DIR=${KDIR} attn attn-paddle
    DEPENDS ${_asm_deps} COMMENT "attention kernels (asm/attn_gen.py)" VERBATIM)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${KERNELS_C}
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${GENK} ${KDIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/.kernels > ${KERNELS_C}
    DEPENDS ${GENK} ${_staged} ${KDIR}/dgemm.cl ${_attn} COMMENT "kernel table kernels.c (ocloc)" VERBATIM)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${KERNELS_GEN8_C}
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${GENK} ${KDIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/.kernels_gen8 bdw > ${KERNELS_GEN8_C}
    DEPENDS ${GENK} ${_staged} ${KDIR}/dgemm.cl COMMENT "Gen8 kernel table kernels_gen8.c (ocloc)" VERBATIM)
endif()
add_custom_target(gen9blas_kernel_tables DEPENDS ${KERNELS_C} ${KERNELS_GEN8_C})

# ---- kcl ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(KCL_SRC kcl.c kcl_gen8.c ${KERNELS_C} ${KERNELS_GEN8_C})

# libkcl.a: kcl for programs with their own kernel table (apps): symbols hidden, so each shared object linking it keeps
# its own instance. The program table (kcl_programs / kcl_nprograms) comes from the program's gen_kernels.py output.
add_library(gen9blas_kcl STATIC kcl.c)
target_include_directories(gen9blas_kcl PRIVATE ${MESA}
  PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/gen9blas>)
target_compile_options(gen9blas_kcl PRIVATE -Wall -fvisibility=hidden)
set_target_properties(gen9blas_kcl PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME kcl EXPORT_NAME kcl)
target_link_libraries(gen9blas_kcl PUBLIC ${M_LIB} Threads::Threads)

# ---- the library -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(LIB_SRC src/core.c src/gemm.c src/packed.c src/ops.c src/level3.c src/level12.c)
add_library(gen9blas SHARED ${LIB_SRC} src/attn.c ${KCL_SRC})
target_include_directories(gen9blas PRIVATE ${MESA} src
  PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_compile_options(gen9blas PRIVATE -Wall -fvisibility=hidden)
target_link_libraries(gen9blas PRIVATE ${M_LIB} Threads::Threads)
set_target_properties(gen9blas PROPERTIES VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}.${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR}
  PUBLIC_HEADER "gen9blas.h;gen9blas_ml.h" INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN" BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON)
add_library(gen9blas::gen9blas ALIAS gen9blas)
add_library(gen9blas::kcl ALIAS gen9blas_kcl)

if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_BLAS_SHIM)
  set(_cbd ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cblas)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_cbd}/cblas_d.inc
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${_cbd}
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_blas_d.py ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cblas.c > ${_cbd}/cblas_d.inc
    DEPENDS gen_blas_d.py src/cblas.c VERBATIM)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_cbd}/cblas_forward.c
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_forward.py ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/blas_symbols.txt
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cblas.c ${_cbd}/cblas_d.inc > ${_cbd}/cblas_forward.c
    DEPENDS gen_forward.py blas_symbols.txt src/cblas.c ${_cbd}/cblas_d.inc VERBATIM)
  add_library(gen9blas_blas SHARED ${LIB_SRC} ${KCL_SRC} src/cblas.c ${_cbd}/cblas_forward.c ${_cbd}/cblas_d.inc)
  target_include_directories(gen9blas_blas PRIVATE ${MESA} src . ${_cbd})
  target_compile_options(gen9blas_blas PRIVATE -Wall)
  target_link_libraries(gen9blas_blas PRIVATE ${M_LIB} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} Threads::Threads)
  set_target_properties(gen9blas_blas PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
endif()

if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_NEO)
  find_package(OpenCL REQUIRED)
  add_library(gen9blas_neo SHARED ${LIB_SRC})
  target_compile_definitions(gen9blas_neo PRIVATE GEN9BLAS_NEO)
  target_include_directories(gen9blas_neo PRIVATE src .)
  target_compile_options(gen9blas_neo PRIVATE -Wall -fvisibility=hidden)
  target_link_libraries(gen9blas_neo PRIVATE OpenCL::OpenCL ${M_LIB} Threads::Threads)
endif()

# ---- Gen8 bring-up tools (docs/gen8.md 6a; run on a Gen8 Cherryview only) ----------------------------------------
option(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_GEN8_TOOLS "test_gen8_probe / bench_gen8 (own Gen8 table with the probe kernel; needs ocloc)" OFF)
if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_GEN8_TOOLS AND NOT GEN9BLAS_PREBUILT_KERNELS)
  set(_probe_c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kernels_gen8_probe.c)
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_probe_c}
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${GENK} ${KDIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/.kernels_gen8_probe bdw-probe > ${_probe_c}
    DEPENDS ${GENK} ${_staged} ${KDIR}/dgemm.cl VERBATIM)
  foreach(t test_gen8_probe bench_gen8)
    add_executable(${t} ${t}.c kcl.c kcl_gen8.c ${KERNELS_C} ${_probe_c})
    target_include_directories(${t} PRIVATE ${MESA} .)
    target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE ${M_LIB} Threads::Threads)
  endforeach()
endif()

# ---- tests (Python suites against NumPy / OpenBLAS; need the GPU) ---------------------------------------------------
if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  set(_env GEN9BLAS_LIB=$<TARGET_FILE:gen9blas> SKIP_BIG=1)
  if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_BLAS_SHIM)
    list(APPEND _env GEN9BLAS_BLAS_LIB=$<TARGET_FILE:gen9blas_blas>)
  endif()
  foreach(t basic errors level3 level12 userptr skinny packed long_launch blas blas_d blas_banded)
    if(t MATCHES "^blas" AND NOT GEN9BLAS_BUILD_BLAS_SHIM)
      continue()
    endif()
    add_test(NAME gen9blas_${t} COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/test_${t}.py
             WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    set_tests_properties(gen9blas_${t} PROPERTIES LABELS gpu ENVIRONMENT "${_env}" RESOURCE_LOCK gpu TIMEOUT 900)
  endforeach()
endif()

# ---- install + package files -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
install(TARGETS gen9blas gen9blas_kcl EXPORT gen9blasTargets
  LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  PUBLIC_HEADER DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
if(GEN9BLAS_BUILD_BLAS_SHIM)
  install(TARGETS gen9blas_blas LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
endif()
install(FILES kcl.h kcl_desc.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/gen9blas)
install(PROGRAMS gen_kernels.py DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/gen9blas)
install(FILES gen9blas.py DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/gen9blas/python)
list(TRANSFORM KERNEL_FILES PREPEND kernels/ OUTPUT_VARIABLE _kinst)   # for programs embedding library kernels
install(FILES ${_kinst} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/gen9blas/kernels)
install(FILES cmake/gen9blasKernels.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/gen9blas)
install(EXPORT gen9blasTargets NAMESPACE gen9blas:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/gen9blas)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/gen9blasConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blasConfig.cmake
  INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/gen9blas PATH_VARS CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blasConfigVersion.cmake COMPATIBILITY SameMinorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blasConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blasConfigVersion.cmake
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/gen9blas)
configure_file(cmake/gen9blas.pc.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blas.pc @ONLY)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen9blas.pc DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig)
# in-tree users (top-level build): what find_package(gen9blas) provides
if(NOT PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
  set(GEN9BLAS_GEN_KERNELS ${GENK} PARENT_SCOPE)
  set(GEN9BLAS_KERNELS_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kernels PARENT_SCOPE)
  set(GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION ${GEN9BLAS_OCLOC_VERSION} PARENT_SCOPE)
  set(gen9blas_FOUND TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
endif()
include(cmake/gen9blasKernels.cmake)
